content.text: {"verdict":"pass","reasons":["Deviation is correctly identified: Section 5's representations cover legality, authority and non-infringement only; Paragraph 1(b)'s professional-and-workmanlike language is a performance covenant, and Paragraph 5(e) disclaims implied warranties, so there is no conformance warranty, period or remedy — a legitimate insert under the rule's detection guidance.","Inserted Paragraph 5(f) reaches the preferred position: workmanlike-performance warranty, 12-month deliverable/Works conformance to Specifications and documentation (90 days for services-only work), no-malicious-code warranty, and an express repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy at Contractor's option, mirroring the model language and using contract-native terms (Services, Works, Specifications, Company, Contractor).","Edit is additive and minimal: p0030 is left verbatim and the express-warranty carve-out from the disclaimer is handled by a single cross-reference sentence rather than rewriting the all-caps disclaimer; deterministic checks (operation applies, period ≥ 90 days) both pass.","Comment is accurate, correctly prefixed, concise, states what changed and why, and offers the playbook fallback (90 days deliverables / 30 days Services) without lecturing.","Minor, non-disqualifying nit: because 5(e) is an 'in lieu of' clause that already preserves express warranties, the final anti-disclaimer sentence is belt-and-suspenders rather than strictly necessary; it is harmless and pro-Customer."]}

reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: Section 5's representations cover legality, authority and non-infringement only; Paragraph 1(b)'s professional-and-workmanlike language is a performance covenant, and Paragraph 5(e) disclaims implied warranties, so there is no conformance warranty, period or remedy — a legitimate insert under the rule's detection guidance.

Inserted Paragraph 5(f) reaches the preferred position: workmanlike-performance warranty, 12-month deliverable/Works conformance to Specifications and documentation (90 days for services-only work), no-malicious-code warranty, and an express repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy at Contractor's option, mirroring the model language and using contract-native terms (Services, Works, Specifications, Company, Contractor).

Edit is additive and minimal: p0030 is left verbatim and the express-warranty carve-out from the disclaimer is handled by a single cross-reference sentence rather than rewriting the all-caps disclaimer; deterministic checks (operation applies, period ≥ 90 days) both pass.
Comment is accurate, correctly prefixed, concise, states what changed and why, and offers the playbook fallback (90 days deliverables / 30 days Services) without lecturing.

Minor, non-disqualifying nit: because 5(e) is an 'in lieu of' clause that already preserves express warranties, the final anti-disclaimer sentence is belt-and-suspenders rather than strictly necessary; it is harmless and pro-Customer.
